rules.name: brkem_gap
rules._desc: Accepted 8080-mode entry. Positional: first divergent row must be at or after the chip CODE-fetch row that fetched the BRKEM opcode; a divergence before that is a real bug and the rule refuses. Optional IVT-2xMEMR + 3xMEMW push signature upgrades the reason.

rules.name: cadence_floor
rules._desc: Documented waits>=1/wrand cadence-drift floor (biu_model.md:287-536). FROZEN 2026-07-27 from calibration over the 59-seed known-floor corpus (cached w1/w3 chip refs vs current-RTL TB).
rules._provenance: Observed per-step |delta o| distribution was bimodal: a tight cluster at {0,1,2} (normal drift) plus an odd-parity stall family at exactly {8,9,10}, ALL at w1 (odd wait count) - the documented odd-parity 8-cycle stall (biu_model.md). Per the plan, max_step raised 4->9 to admit the legitimate 8/9-clock odd-parity stalls; the single step=10 tail (seed 90042 w1) is deliberately left to surface as TIMING (a conservative top-decile outlier reported for manual review, never silently masked). slip_per_waited_fetch_max/abs_slip_cap/spec_skip_frac_max unchanged: observed worst slip/waited-fetch rate 0.214 < 0.25, |o| peak 10 << 64 cap, fetch-alignment skip fraction 0.000 (perfect) << 0.05. Floor accept-rate with these thresholds: 58/59 = 98.3% (>= the 90% gate).
